note: write_image: 'let filter = if smoothing_enabled {..} else {..}' selects the image scaling filter kind - matches the doc comment's own explanation of the flag.
emit_target_available_or_destroyed: 'if available { "target-available-form" } else { "target-destroyed-form" }' picks the reply's type_ string directly from the flag.

ClosestFragment::should_replace: point_in_vertical_bounds is compared against self.point_in_vertical_bounds in two early-return branches deciding whether a new candidate fragment wins the closest-hit-test comparison.
glyphs: include_whitespace is an operand of '!shaped_text_slice.is_whitespace() || include_whitespace' filtering which glyphs get emitted into the display list.
BlockContainer::construct: is_list_item is an operand of 'if is_list_item && let Some((marker_info, marker_contents)) = ...make_marker(...)' gating list-marker construction.

cached_same_formatting_context_block_if_applicable: has_inline_parent is one operand of a big OR'd cache-invalidation condition ('result.has_inline_parent != has_inline_parent || ...') deciding whether the cached layout result can be reused.

set_accessibility_active (LayoutThread's, distinct from the servoshell one already triaged as needs_discussion): 'if !active { clear tree; return }' vs falling through to build/update the accessibility tree - real distinct behavior, not just a no-op guard.
create_fragment: 'if is_collapsed' (later in the body) special-cases fragment sizing for collapsed table cells.

propagate_damage_to_children: has_dirty_descendants is an operand of 'if has_dirty_descendants || damage_for_children.intersects(...)' deciding whether to traverse children at all - a real perf-critical early-out.
get_oldest_accessed: is_secure_cookie is an operand of '(c.cookie.secure().unwrap_or(false) == is_secure_cookie) && ...' filtering the eviction search to same-security-class cookies only.
get_token_for_file: allow_revoked is an operand of '!allow_revoked && !entry.is_valid_url...' deciding whether a revoked blob URL is still granted a token, with a warn log tied to the flag.
set_blob_url_validity: 'if !validity { ... check zero_refs/no_outstanding_tokens for cleanup eligibility ... }' - real extra behavior triggered only when invalidating, not just a value store.

SetDataAttributes: 'if allow' (Step 5 of the linked WHATWG spec algorithm) branches to add-vs-remove attribute-name entries. Genuine hit, but the exact signature/param name is spec-mandated (WebIDL setDataAttributes(boolean allow)), so renaming per the suggested refactor isn't really an option here.

set_accessibility_active: 'if active == was_active { return }' is a no-op change-detection guard, not a behavior-mode dispatch - active itself is just propagated unconditionally afterward (webview.set_accessibility_active(active)); similar in kind to the ripgrep skip_stdout builder-setter case.
